global.title: The rideshare era is ending. Small satellites need anchor customers for small launch, now.
global.summary: If your small satellite is supposed to fly in 2029, you probably don’t have a ride yet. And the cheapest seat in the business is no longer taking your booking.

global.summary: ANTALYA, Turkey — A Crew Dragon returned to Earth Oct. 8 after nearly eight months in space, completing the Crew-12 mission to the International Space Station.

global.title: Russia may turn to nuclear space weapons to counter U.S. missile defenses, report says
global.summary: WASHINGTON — Russia has strong military and economic incentives to develop nuclear weapons and electronic-warfare systems capable of disrupting U.S. satellites, particularly as Washington expands space-based surveillance and missile defenses, according to a new study published Oct. 8 .
